products.title: MYAVANA HairAI™ Instant Analysis + Recommendations
products.short_description: AI-powered instant hair analysis that eliminates trial and error from your hair care routine.
products.full_description: Are you tired of wasting money and time trying to find hair products that work for you? You've probably spent countless hours searching YouTube, Pinterest, or Instagram trying to find products that work for you based on someone who has hair that 'looks like yours' but the products still don't work. Did you know that your hair is as unique as your fingerprint? What may work for someone else's hair (even if it looks similar to yours) more times than not, won't work for you. That's why we created Myavana HairAI™, a unique hair analysis that eliminates trial and error from your hair care routine.
what_is_included: Unique analysis of your hair type and texture
Instant product recommendations with the right ingredients for you
Ongoing recommendations throughout your hair journey
MYAVANA Member benefits: hair care concierge, virtual consultations, stylist referrals, virtual community, exclusive hair parties and more
products.key_benefit: Personalized hair product recommendations based on YOUR unique hair — not someone else's
mya_talking_points: Only $9 — most affordable entry point to personalized hair care

Unlocks ongoing Mya membership benefits
